 Present:

Sri E. Rajeeva Gowda, L.L.M.
 Xlv Addl. City Civil & Sessions Judge, Bengaluru.

(By the learned Public Prosecutor)
AND Shivakumar,
S/o Karigowda,
Aged about 34 years,
R/at Siddeshwara village,
Gopal Post,
Lakvalli Hobli,
Tharikere Taluk,

(By Sri.GNK., Advocate)
 ... ACCUSED  2 S.C.No.215/2019  * *

* * *
 JUDGMENT

The PSI, Sanjayanagar Police Station, Bangalore City, has filed charge sheet against accused for the offences punishable U/s.498A, 307 of IPC.
2.

The brief story of the prosecution case is as under:-

1
The marriage between the C.W.2 Smt.Shruthi and accused was performed on 09.12.2012 and were residing since 7 months in the outhouse at House No.375, 5 th Main, 12th cross, HIG.Colony, Bengaluru.
The accused everyday started to quarrel with C.W.2 for silly reasons and thereby tortured physically and mentally.
On 04.06.2018 at 12.30 p.m when the accused returned from his work, the same was questioned by C.W.2.

Due to said reasons, on same day at 5.00 p.m the accused abused her in filthy language and tortured physically and mentally and with an intention to kill C.W.2, hold her tuft and cut her both side neck with knife, due to which she has sustained grievous injuries and thereby accused has committed the offences as alleged against him.
3. The concerned police have submitted charge sheet before the concerned ACMM., Bangalore.
The learned Magistrate has took cognizance of the offences and committed the case to the Sessions Court by complying Sec.207 of Cr.P.C. after furnishing copy of charge sheet to the accused.

The same was numbered as SC No.215/2019.
4.
The prosecution has examined ten witnesses as PW.1 to PW.10 and got exhibited documents at Ex.P1 to P15 and M.O.1 to M.O.8.
On the basis of the evidence of the witnesses, the learned PP has given up C.W.11 to 13.
The witness C.W.3 reported as dead.

5. After completion of prosecution side evidence, this Court has recorded the statement of accused,
as provided U/s.313 of Cr.P.C.
The accused has denied incriminating evidence present against him and not claimed any defense evidence nor submitted anything to the Court.
The accused has complied application u/s.437A of Cr.PC by executing personal bond and surety bond.

6. Heard the arguments on both sides and perused the materials on record.
7.

The following points that arises for consideration of this court:
1. Whether the prosecution proves that the marriage between the complainant and accused was performed on 09.12.2012 and were residing since 7 months in the outhouse at House No.375, 5th Main, 12th cross, HIG.Colony, Bengaluru, the accused everyday started to quarrel with C.W.2 for silly reasons and thereby tortured physically and mentally and thereby committed the offence punishable under Section 498(A) of IPC?
2. Whether the prosecution proves that on 04.06.2018 at 12.30 p.m when the accused returned from his work, the same was questioned by C.W.2, on same day at 5.00 p.m., the accused abused her in filthy language and tortured her physically and mentally and with an intention to kill the C.W.2, hold her tuft and cut her both side neck with knife, due to which she has sustained grievous injuries and thereby accused has committed an offence punishable U/s.307 of IPC?
3. What order?

Sanjayanagara Ps vs Shiva Kumar on 27 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/165629257/
2 8.

This Court has answered the above above points are as under:
 Point No.1: In the Negative  Point No.2: In the Negative  Point No.3: As per final order  for the following:
 R E A S O N S 9.
Points Nos.1 and 2: These points are taken up together as they are related to each other and to avoid repetition in the discussion.
In this case, the prosecution examined the victim by name Shruthi as P.W.2.
The mother of the victim by name Mangalamma examined as P.W.3.
The father of the victim by name Chandrappa reported as dead.
Even the evidence of PW.3 discloses that the father of victim is dead.
The victim by name Shruthi being the wife of the accused has categorically deposed before the court about the death of her father and her relationship with the witness P.W.1 and P.W.3.
The marriage between the accused and the victim P.W.2 performed on 09.12.2012.
After marriage they started to reside at Sanjay Nagar.
The accused was working as a Watchman, due to the marital relationship, she had given birth to a male and female child.
According to the said victim, there was no quarrel between her and accused.
The accused never tortured either physically or mentally and no incident happened on 04.06.2018 at 12.30 noon and accused not assaulted with a knife to kill her.
Further evidence also reveals that she has not taken treatment in the hospital and police have not recorded her statement.
There was just oral exchange of words between her and accused for the reason accused not properly taking care of family, except that nothing has happened.
The evidence of the mother of the victim by name Mangalamma examined as P.W.3 also very similar to the evidence of the witness P.W.2.
She has not supported the story of the prosecution by giving adverse evidence towards her statement.

10. It is necessary to note that the pancha P.W.5 Jagadish, P.W.6 Suresh, another witness Suresh examined as P.W.8 being the signatories to the Mahazar Ex.P.7 and witness to the alleged incident also not supported the prosecution story by deposing accused not assaulted the victim P.W.2 with knife with an intention to kill her on 04.06.2018 at 12.30 noon.
The said three witnesses have given clear evidence about the relationship between the accused and victim.

Except that nothing has been stated by the said witnesses P.W.6 to P.W.8.
11.

The other pancha witness and witness to the incident by name Manjunatha, Rajesh examined as P.W.7 and P.W.9 respectively and got marked their signatures present on the seizure Mahazar at Ex.P.10, but it is the say of P.W.7 and P.W.9 that there was no any quarrel between the accused and the victim.
The accused never tortured the victim either physically or mentally.
On 04.06.2018 at 12.30 noon the accused has not assaulted P.W.2 with knife with an intention to kill her and police have not seized any material object in their presence by conducting Mahazar.
But the police have obtained their signatures on the documents in police station.
The said witnesses have deposed contrary evidence to their respective statements.

As such the learned PP has cross-examined the Sanjayanagara Ps vs Shiva Kumar on 27 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/165629257/
3 witnesses P.W.2, P.W.3, P.W.5 to PW.9 with regard to the incident and also Mahazar.
The all said witnesses completely denied the suggestions made by the learned PP related to the contents of the Mahazar and statements.

As such, the evidence given by the said witnesses P.W.2, P.W.3, P.W.5 to P.W.9 completely contrary to the story of the prosecution and thereby not helpful in any angle to prove the allegations made against accused.
12. It is necessary to note that the brother of the victim by name Pradeep examined as PW.1.
The said witness P.W.1 has categorically deposed about his relationship with the victim.
So also he has categorically deposed about the marriage between sister Shruthi with accused, after marriage, they started to reside at Siddapura, located in Badravathi Taluk.
After 2 years, the P.W.2 and accused were started to reside at Koramangala separately after quarreling with the parents of accused.
The accused was doing vegetable selling business.
The accused used to consume liquor and started to harass the P.W.2 physically and mentally and same was informed to him.
About 7 months back to the date of alleged incident, accused started to reside at Dollars colony alongwith his wife and children.
The accused was started to work as Security guard and P.W.2 was serving as maid servant.
Even at Dollars colony, the accused tortured his sister P.W.2 physically and mentally.
In the month of June 2018, the accused has contacted him and requested to come to his house as he and his wife quarreled with each other.
Immediately, he alongwith his mother C.W3 went to the house of accused where blood was present in the room.

They heard from the neighbours that the accused has assaulted C.W.2 on the left side of the neck with knife and his sister was taken to M.S.Ramaiah hospital for treatment by the persons of the locality.
Immediately, they went to the hospital and saw that his sister was not in a position to speak and noticed blood was oozing from the neck of the victim P.W.2.
As such, on the same day, he went and lodged complaint as per Ex.P.1.
Later, when P.W.2 got conscious, he came to know about the incident.
The marriage invitation and photos have been marked at Ex.P.2 and Ex.P.3 respectively.

Though the said witness has supported the prosecution story in his chief-examination, but during cross-examination of accused counsel, the said witness P.W1 has completely changed his versions by deposing accused was leading their happy marital life alongwith his sister P.W.2.
He does not have any bad habits like consuming of liquor and he never tortured his sister physically.
The accused never abused P.W.2 in filthy language and also never assaulted with knife with an intention to kill P.W.2.
So also, admitted nothing has happened as deposed in his chief-examination.
He has not lodged complaint so far as alleged incident is concerned and police have not recorded his statement.
Due to the silly disputes between the accused and his sister P.W.2, he went to the police station where police have taken his signature on the documents.

According to P.W.1, he has not given instructions to prepare Ex.P.1, since the version of P.W.1 completely contrary to his chief-examination, but the then learned PP instead of treating the witness as hostile has re- examined the witness P.W.1.
The suggestion of learned PP shows that both family have settled the dispute.
So, it is very clear that even the evidence of P.W.1 not helpful for the prosecution to prove the allegations made against the accused.
13. It is pertinent to note that the witness P.W.4 Dr.Sudhakar who has came to the hospital on 04.06.2018 at 6.00 p.m on the say of the assault.
He has given evidence as per the wound certificate marked at Ex.P.6 and identified the knife marked at M.O.1.
The said evidence of the doctor remained as unchallenged, but the evidence of PW.2 is very specific that she has not taken treatment in the hospital.
So, the evidence of the victim not match with the evidence of the Medical Officer.

Sanjayanagara Ps vs Shiva Kumar on 27 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/165629257/
4 14.
The police witness P.W.10 Sri.Mestri Nayak, the then PSI has deposed that on 04.06.2018 at 7.15 p.m complainant had came to the police station and lodged complaint.
The same was reduced into writing and after read over to the complainant has taken his signatures and registered FIR vide Cr.No.111/2018.
On 05.06.2018 went to the spot, conducted Mahazar Ex.P.7 in the presence of C.W.7 and C.W8 as shown by C.W.5 and collected the blood stained mud and also sample mud.
He has brought the said M.Os into P.F.No.37/2018.
On the same day collected blood stained clothes belongs to P.W.2 and brought into P.F.No.38/2018.
He has identified M.Os marked at M.O.4 to 6 respectively.
On 06.06.2018, accused was produced before him, he has carried out arrest procedure and recorded his voluntary statement.

In view of voluntary statement marked at Ex.P.15, the said accused was taken to his house on 07.06.2018, where he was residing alongwith his wife and two children and carried out Mahazar in the presence of C.W.8 and C.W.9.
The accused has produced the knife and blood stained jeans pant and shirt.
The said M.Os were seized and prepared Mahazar as per Ex.P.10 accordingly.
The said seized M.Os brought into P.F.No.40/2018 and the said blood stained clothes of accused have been marked at M.O.7 and M.O.8.
Thereafter accused was produced to the court alongwith remand application after medical examination with proper escort.
He has recorded statements of the witnesses.
On 29.06.2018 collected the wound certificate as per Ex.P.6 and as the investigation was completed, submitted charge sheet against the accused on 10.10.2018.
The entire evidence of the said witnesses has denied completely by the accused counsel.

In this case,
except the evidence of the official witnesses, no other independent witnesses supported the prosecution story.
Initially i.e. in the chief-examination of P.W.1, the P.W.1 has supported prosecution story, but the cross-examination completely destroyed his evidence deposed during his chief- examination.
As because the way of answer given by P.W.1 contrary not only to the story of the prosecution, but also to his own evidence deposed during the chief-examination.
Such being the case, it is very clear that the prosecution has utterly failed to place any evidence to establish the guilt against the accused.
As such, this court has answered the Point Nos.1 and 2 in the Negative.
15. Point No.3:

In view of answer of this court on points No.1 and 2, this court proceed to pass the following:
O R D E R U/s.235(1) of Cr.P.C. the accused is hereby acquitted of the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 307 of IPC.

The M.O.1 to 8 being plastic handle knife, blood mixed mud, sample mud, chudidhar top, bra, chudidhar pant, jeans pant of accused, shirt are being worthless are ordered to be destroyed after expiry of appeal time.
